entry.content:
• (Google Cloud CLI) Removed the gcloud-man-pages component. Use --help for full command documentation.
  • (App Engine) Removed the app-engine-grpc component from the Google Cloud CLI.
  • (Cloud Build) Removed the Cloud Build Local Builder component (cloud-build-local) from the Google Cloud CLI.
entry.summary: Several components have been removed from the Google Cloud CLI, including gcloud-man-pages, app-engine-grpc, and Cloud Build Local Builder. Users should now rely on the --help flag for documentation.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: CLI components removed

entry.content: • Updated bundled Python on Linux and Windows, and in the Alpine-based Docker images, to pyOpenSSL 26.4.0 and cryptography 50.0.1. 32-bit Windows uses pyOpenSSL 26.2.0 and cryptography 48.0.1, the newest releases that support it.
entry.summary: The Google Cloud CLI has updated its bundled Python versions on Linux, Windows, and Docker images. These updates include the latest stable releases of pyOpenSSL and cryptography, ensuring enhanced security and compatibility for users.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: CLI Python updates

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud beta ai endpoints deploy-model to request automatic resources for Gemini deployments on GDC connected endpoints.
  • If no replica counts are specified, the minimum replica count defaults to 1 only for gemini-2.5-flash.
  • Specifying flags that apply only to dedicated resources, such as --machine-type or --accelerator, now prints a warning and deploys with dedicated resources.
entry.summary: New features simplify AI model deployment, including automatic resource allocation for Gemini models on GDC connected endpoints. Default replica counts are set for specific Gemini versions, and warnings are issued for incompatible resource flags.
entry.title: AI: AI model deployment updates

entry.content: • Added gcloud beta agent-identity auth-providers resolve-authorization command.
entry.summary: A new command, `gcloud beta agent-identity auth-providers resolve-authorization`, has been added to manage agent identity authorization. This enhancement provides more granular control over how agents authenticate and are authorized within your systems.
entry.title: Agent Identity: New command for agent identity

entry.content: • Added --enable-public-dns flag to gcloud beta alloydb instances create|update.
entry.summary: You can now enable public DNS for AlloyDB instances during creation or update using the `--enable-public-dns` flag in the `gcloud beta alloydb instances` command. This simplifies network configuration for your database instances.
entry.title: AlloyDB: AlloyDB instances: public DNS enabled

entry.content: • Fixed an issue where gcloud apigee commands would fail with an UnauthorizedRequestError for users who authenticate using Mutual TLS (mTLS).
entry.summary: An issue with Apigee mTLS authentication has been resolved. Users authenticating via mTLS will no longer encounter UnauthorizedRequestError when using gcloud apigee commands.
entry.title: Apigee: Apigee mTLS authentication fix

entry.content: • Updated gcloud beta app migrate-to-run to default to the App Engine application's region instead of us-central1 when neither --region nor the run/region property is set.
entry.summary: The `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command now defaults to using the App Engine application's region instead of `us-central1`. This change applies when neither the `--region` flag nor the `run/region` property is explicitly set, ensuring migrations are more contextually placed.
entry.title: App Engine: App Engine migration to Cloud Run defaults to application region

entry.content:
• Promoted --federated-catalog-identity-mode for gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs create to GA.
  • Promoted --federated-catalog-identity-mode for gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs update to GA.
  • Promoted --metadata-service-directory-name for gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs create to GA.
  • Promoted --metadata-service-directory-name for gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs update to GA.
  • federated value for --catalog-type flag of gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs create is now supported.
entry.summary: Key features for managing BigLake Iceberg catalogs are now generally available, including federated catalog identity modes and metadata service directory names. Support for federated catalog types has also been introduced, simplifying data integration and management.
entry.title: BigLake: BigLake Catalog Management Enhancements

entry.content: • Added --filter flag to gcloud privateca subordinates list. The flag is able to allow filtering results based on specified boolean expression.
entry.summary: You can now filter subordinate CAs using the new --filter flag in the `gcloud privateca subordinates list` command. This flag allows for flexible filtering of results based on a boolean expression.
entry.title: Certificate Authority Service: Filter subordinate CAs

entry.content: • Build with 1.26.4 to resolve CVE-2026-39820.
entry.summary: The Cloud Bigtable client library has been updated to version 1.26.4 to address a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-39820). Please update your applications to ensure continued security and stability.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable: Bigtable client library update

entry.content: • Rebuild cbt-emulator for CVE-2026-39820.
entry.summary: The Cloud Bigtable emulator has been rebuilt to address CVE-2026-39820. This update ensures enhanced security for the emulator.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable Emulator: Bigtable emulator rebuilt

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud dataflow config-store-settings to GA.
entry.summary: The `gcloud dataflow config-store-settings` command is now generally available. This feature allows you to manage your Dataflow pipeline settings efficiently.
entry.title: Cloud Dataflow: Dataflow settings now generally available

entry.content:
• Fixed gcloud dataplex dbt metadata-jobs create so that dbt resources whose names contain a dot, such as tests on a model with a decimal version, are no longer rejected by the import job.
  • Fixed gcloud dataplex dbt metadata-jobs create so that two dbt resources that map to the same Dataplex entry ID no longer fail the whole import job. The first is imported and a warning names the other.
entry.summary: The Dataplex dbt metadata import jobs have been fixed to correctly handle resource names with dots and to allow for duplicate resource mappings by issuing a warning instead of failing the entire job.
entry.title: Cloud Dataplex: Dataplex dbt import fixes

entry.content: • Added --vendor-type flag to gcloud iam workforce-pools providers create-oidc, create-saml, update-oidc, and update-saml commands.
entry.summary: New flags have been added to commands for creating and updating OIDC and SAML workforce identity pool providers. These flags allow for specifying the vendor type of the provider.
entry.title: Cloud IAM: Workforce identity pool provider updates

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud resource-manager capability-configs to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud resource-manager boundary-configs to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud resource-manager boundaries to GA.
entry.summary: The Cloud Resource Manager API now offers General Availability for capability configurations, boundary configurations, and boundaries. This release signifies a stable and production-ready version of these essential resource management features.
entry.title: Cloud Resource Manager: Resource Manager APIs reach General Availability

entry.content: • Added --dry-run flag to gcloud beta run domain-mappings create to validate a domain mapping, including whether the domain is available, without creating it.
entry.summary: You can now use the `--dry-run` flag with `gcloud beta run domain-mappings create` to validate your domain mapping before it's created. This helps ensure the domain is available and the mapping is valid without making any changes.
entry.title: Cloud Run: Dry run for domain mapping

entry.content:
• Added POSTGRES_19 to --database-version flag of gcloud sql instances create and gcloud sql instances patch.
  • Added --no-replication-lag-max-seconds-for-recreate flag to gcloud beta sql instances patch to disable recreating a lagging MySQL read replica.
  • Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.26.2 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.
entry.summary: The latest update to Cloud SQL includes support for PostgreSQL 19, enhanced control over MySQL read replica recreation, and an updated Cloud SQL Proxy version.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: New Cloud SQL features available

entry.content: • Improved error output when gcloud spanner cli runs an incompatible spanner-cli binary found on PATH instead of the spanner-cli component; users are now directed to install the component.
entry.summary: The Cloud Spanner CLI now provides clearer error messages when an incompatible binary is found on PATH. Users will be guided to install the correct spanner-cli component for a smoother experience.
entry.title: Cloud Spanner: Cloud Spanner CLI Error Improvement

entry.content: • Added enable-automatic-failover to --boost-config flag in gcloud beta workstations configs create and gcloud beta workstations configs update.
entry.summary: Cloud Workstations now supports automatic failover for enhanced reliability. This feature can be enabled using the `enable-automatic-failover` option within the `--boost-config` flag for creating and updating workstation configurations.
entry.title: Cloud Workstations: Workstations failover support

entry.content:
• Added compute instance-templates export command to all release tracks.
  • Removed WORKLOAD_IDENTITY choise in --identity-type flag.
  • Promoted --instance-flexibility-policy flag and min CPU platform and disk overrides to GA for gcloud compute instance-groups managed create and update.
  • Added compute instance-templates import command to all release tracks.
entry.summary: New commands for instance templates and updates to managed instance groups are now available. The `instance-templates export` and `import` commands are added, and instance flexibility policies are promoted to GA.
entry.title: Compute Engine: New Compute Engine features

entry.content: • Added --failback flag to gcloud database-migration migration-jobs promote command to promote a migration job from destination back to source during the FAILBACK phase.
entry.summary: A new --failback flag has been added to the promote command for migration jobs. This allows users to promote a migration job from its destination back to the source during the failback phase.
entry.title: Database Migration: Promote Migration Job with Failback Option

entry.content:
• Promoted --view, --memberships, --filter, and --sort-by flags on gcloud container fleet|hub config-management describe command to GA.
  • Updated gcloud container fleet|hub memberships register to allow skipping the Connect agent installation on non-GKE clusters via the --no-install-connect-agent flag.
entry.summary: New features for GKE Hub's Configuration Management are now generally available, including advanced filtering and sorting options. Additionally, registering non-GKE clusters is simplified with the ability to skip agent installation.
entry.title: GKE Hub: GKE Hub Configuration Management Enhancements

entry.content:
• Added the reservedSystemCpus kubelet config option to the gcloud container clusters create, gcloud container node-pools create, and gcloud container node-pools update commands. This option specifies the list of CPUs reserved for host system services.
  • Added ltsc2025 option to --windows-os-version flag of gcloud container node-pools create and gcloud container node-pools update to create or update Windows node pools using the Windows Server 2025 (LTSC2025) image.
  • Updated default kubectl to 1.35.9.
  • Additional kubectl versions:
  • 1.31.14
  • 1.32.13
  • 1.33.13
  • 1.34.12
  • 1.35.9
  • 1.36.5
  • 1.37.1
  • Allowed --num-nodes=0 for gcloud container clusters create to create a cluster without a default node pool on GKE versions that support it. Flags that only configure the default node pool, such as --machine-type and --enable-autoscaling, can't be used with --num-nodes=0.
entry.summary: New options for CPU reservation and Windows Server 2025 node pools are now available. You can also create clusters without a default node pool and access updated kubectl versions.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: Kubernetes Engine Updates

entry.content: • Added --purpose flag to gcloud network-connectivity internal-ranges create to specify the purpose of the internal range.
entry.summary: You can now specify the purpose of an internal range when creating it using the `--purpose` flag with `gcloud network-connectivity internal-ranges create`. This enhancement provides more granular control over network resources.
entry.title: Network Connectivity: New flag for internal ranges

entry.content:
• Promoted --wildfire-analysis-profile flag of gcloud network-security security-profile-groups create and gcloud network-security security-profile-groups update commands to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis command group and its create, delete, describe, list and update commands to GA.
  • Promoted add-submission-rule, delete-submission-rule, add-inline-cloud-analysis-rule and delete-inline-cloud-analysis-rule commands of gcloud network-security security-profiles wildfire-analysis to GA.
entry.summary: The wildfire analysis profile flag and related commands for security profiles have been promoted to General Availability (GA). This includes commands for creating, updating, and managing wildfire analysis profiles and submission rules.
entry.title: Network Security: Network security wildfire analysis GA

entry.content:
• Created a new set of commands for gcloud service-extensions extension-bindings (alpha and beta).
  • Added gcloud beta service-extensions cdn-edge-extensions command group to manage CdnEdgeExtension resources.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: New commands have been added to manage service extension bindings and CDN edge extensions. You can now use `gcloud service-extensions extension-bindings` and `gcloud beta service-extensions cdn-edge-extensions` to manage these resources.
entry.title: Service Extensions: New commands for service extensions
